assayList.name: Thyroid Bioactivity
assayList.description: Assays related to the thyroid adverse outcome pathway network

response.assayComponentEndpointDesc: Data from the assay component CCTE_Deisenroth_TSHR_2D_Ag_TG was analyzed at the assay endpoint, CCTE_Deisenroth_TSHR_2D_Ag_TG_PROT, bidirectionally relative to DMSO as the negative control and baseline of activity. Using a type of functional reporter, gain or loss-of-signal activity can be used to understand changes in thyroid stimulating hormone receptor agonism for thyroglobulin synthesis. To generalize the intended target to other relatable targets, this assay endpoint is annotated to the thyroid intended target family, where the subfamily is thyroglobulin.
response.assayComponentDesc: CCTE_Deisenroth_TSHR_2D_Ag_TG is an assay component calculated from the CCTE_Deisenroth_TSHR_2D_Agonist assay. It is designed to measure thyroglobulin synthesis using a type of functional reporter as detected by absorbance intensity with ELISA technology.
response.assayComponentTargetDesc: Changes in absorbance produced from the functional reporter involving the key reagent, thyroglobulin antibody, are indicative of changes in thyroid stimulating hormone receptor regulation of thyroglobulin synthesis.
response.assayDesc: CCTE_Deisenroth_TSHR_2D_Agonist is a cell-based, single-readout assay that uses human primary thyrocytes. Measurements were taken 96 hours after repeated chemical dosing in a 96-well plate.
response.assaySourceDesc: The Deisenroth laboratory at the EPA Center for Computational Toxicology and Exposure focuses on developing in vitro methods investigating endocrine disruption and developmental toxicity, as well as assays incorporating xenobiotic metabolism.
